tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ha ya gṛ wa ya/ bde gshegs gsung ngag 'phrin las dbang chen sku/ /kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas bstan 'gro'i mgon/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan drin chen rje/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus dpal ldan bzang por 'dud/ /phung khams gdan gsum dkyil 'khor rang bzhin la/ /glo bur sgrib gnyis mun sgrib sbyang ba'i phyir/ /smin byed dbang gi nyi 'od thar 'bras gnyen/ /gzhir gnas dkyil 'khor rab gsal 'di shar bas/ /skal ldan myur lam zab mo la zhugs te/ /rnam grol sku bzhi'i 'bras bzang legs smin pas/ /rgyal ba'i thabs mkhas thugs rje rmad po che/ /yang gsang dbang gi mtshams sbyor bshad kyis nyon/ /de la 'dir pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor ni/ bai ros/ slob ma khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul/ /rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka'i chos bshad la/ /skyabs 'gro smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi/ /phan yon rgyas par bslab bya 'bogs/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug cing gsol btab ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob ma rnams kyis dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi ru dngos su khrus bya ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na chab re blangs te/ bla ma'i drung du yon phul te rim par gral la 'khod do/ /las kyi rdo rjes phyag btsal me tog bkram bsdus byas la/ ngag tu/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu lags/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/

dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes rlan dang bcas me tog gis phyur por bkang nas 'bul lo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ 'o na dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ theg pa chen po'i chos la dad cing / byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skyes nas gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ rnal 'byor chen po'i gral la 'god par byed pa'i dbang dang / byin rlabs nod par byed pa shin tu nas kyang legs/ de la yang dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag byin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de ni skye ba bdun pa la/ /ma bsgom par yang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes tshe 'dir dbang bskur ba thob nas/ de las kyi 'phro byas te/ phyi mar yang dbang thob nas sangs rgya ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /dbang ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ gsang ba snying po las kyang / slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /bsnyen pa la sogs rtsom pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rje theg pa nyams su len par byed pa la/ dbang nges par thob dgos/ dbang ma thob pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang rgyud nyan bshad la sogs pa byed pa ni/

mchog gi dngos grub mi thob par ngan song du skye bar gsungs/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob kyang shi ma thag dmyal bar 'gro ba skyob par mi nus pas/ de'i phyir dbang nod pa la 'bad dgos so/ /de la yang bla ma brgyud pa ji lta bu las yong na/ chos rgyal dbang pos sdes mdzad pa'i gter ston brgya rtsa'i gsol 'debs las/ grags pa sum pa dbang phyug mtshan mtha' can/ /'bre ban tshul bzang rnam gsum tshogs pa'i gter/ /bla ma grub dang yon bdag nag po mkhar/ /gnyis tshogs gter sgo 'byed rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i gter ston gsum tshogs ni/ rkyang po grags pa dbang phyug sum pa byang chub tshul khrims/ 'bre shob bla ma gsum gyis yer pa se ba lung nas rta mgrin pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i rgyud man ngag rnams spyan drangs nas 'bru tshang gis gnyags ston la shog ser steng nas chos rgyun lan gcig tsam las spel rgyu ma byung bar gter rngur gyi rkyang po la mdze byung / sum pa 'das/ 'bre smyo bas shog ser rnams rta mgrin gyi grub thob zhu ston bya ba'i lag tu byung yang des zhu sa rtsad ma chod pas las 'phro gter brgyud kyi byin rlabs bka' ma nyams pa yongs grags la med par yun ring 'byams/ ring zhig na grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'dar phyar ru ba zhes bya ba lus brgya dus gcig la ston par nus shing / stong gsum yang yungs 'bru gcig gi nang du chud par nus pa'i mthu stobs mnga' zhing / gzhan yang zil gyis gnon pa de nyid gtsang jo mo nags rgyal na bzhugs pa'i dus su slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhang lo zla grags bya ba'i sngags pa zhig tu sprul nas dbang lung rnams rdzogs par gnang / sngags kyi oṃ de hrīḥru bsgyur la sgrubs shig gsungs/ 'dar phyar gyi bla ma brgya la gter brgyud kyang rtsad chod nas gsan/ de nas rim pa bzhin du chos rgyal bo dong rin chen/

nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ brag dmar ba chos rgyal dpal bzang / kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge rnam grol ba rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang 'tsho'i sde/ rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin chen po kun bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i zhal snga nas kyi bar du brgyud pa zam ma chad par byon pa bzhin kho bos thob pa lags/ 'o na/ da lan gyi chos sam/ dbang ngam/ lam 'di ji lta bu yin snyam na/ spyir yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sems can ma rig pa'i dong du lhung ba la/ 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i chos kyi sgron me ji snyed cig yod pa bsdu na/ mdo dang rgyud gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'di rgyud kyi lugs yin/ de la yang bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyu dang bzhi las/ 'di rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud dbang po yang rab kyi chos yin/ de la yang gsang sngags gsar ma dang rnying ma gnyis las/ 'di rnying ma'i lugs yin/ de la bskyed pa mahā yo ga lung a nu yo ga rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga gsum las/

'di rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i lugs yin/ de las yang gshin rje ro gcig pad+ma ka gcig yang dag me gcig bdud rtsi thigs gcig phur pa srog gcig ma mo snying gcig thig le nyag gcig ste rtsigs kyi chos bdun zhes bya ba yod pa las/ de'i nang nas kyang shin tu zab par byed pa/ yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa lags/ de la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gnyis las/ thun mong gi 'jug pa ni slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i dbang gzhung las/ thun mong skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / /rigs lnga spyi yi dam tshig bzung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar lam log pa mu stegs pa las khyad par du bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ yul dkon mchog gsum mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum du dmigs nas/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la grogs su 'dzin pa'i bsam pas/ zhe thag pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos laྎ tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun laྎ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de ltar byas pas skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom pa thob pa lags/ lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs ma bsags par byang chub kyi sems mi skye bas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i phyir du/ bdun rnam dag bya ba ni/ skyabs 'gro'i skyabs yul sngar bzhin dmigs la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /de ltar tshogs bsags pa'i rgyu las byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur bas/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / sa chen po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis sems can rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / myur du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgya ba'i phyir du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming de zhes bgyi bas kyang sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / myur du mngon par rdzogs pa gsang rgya ba'i phyir du/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyis byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bslab par bgyi'o/ /lam ma rdzogs pa pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa las khyad par du bya ba'i phyir rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/

mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin gyi phung po thibs pa ltar du mos pa mdzod la/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yis/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis bsgrol/ /dbyugs ma byin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /de rnams kyis thun mong gi 'jug pa song nas/

gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa la/ phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug gnyis las/ dang po phyi'i 'jug pa ni/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i dbang gzhung las/ khrus byas nang zhugs maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /pad+ma sems sogs gsol ba btab/ /mig dgab me tog phreng ba byin/ /bdud rtsi sbyin dang bsrung bar bya/ /rigs nges byas shing gnang ba sbyin/ /yang gsang che ba dbyung ba 'am/ /rang gi rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i phyir/ /snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar/ /nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ /ces pa ltar/ dang po khrus byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ las bum gyi chu dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing khrus byas te/ phyi'i 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu zhes dang / maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ pad+ma sems sogs khyod la 'dud/ /thar lam chen po bdag 'dod de/ /de nyid dbang dang dngos grub rnams/ /mgon po dpa' bos skyabs gsol zhing / /theg chen khang par bzhugs pa dang / /mkhyen rab ye shes bdag la gsol/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las/ ras gos dmar pos gdong g.yogs bcings/ /zhes pa ltar/ slob ma rnams ma rig pa dang sred pa'i ling thog gis bsgribs te/ sngon chad yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'am mthong yang bskyar nas mthong ba'i brdar ras dmar po'i gdong g.yogs bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ bi ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcings/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las/ rigs dang bskal ba nges pa'i phyir/ /me tog srin lag g.yon la dkri/ /zhes pa ltar/ me tog gi phreng ba phyag len la nas 'bru lnga'i dkyil du bug pa phug ste skud pa rgyus pa'i rtser gos kyi lce leb lnga brtsegs mdzad/ srin lag g.yon pa la bcings shing / u dum wā ra man+dha ra/ /yongs 'du dang ni kar ṇi ka /ma li ka yi phreng ba 'di/

/legs par nod la bus zungs shig /ces brjod do/ /nang gi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ bdud rtsi sbyin zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs/ phyi'i bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ na mo bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam rgyal ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rigs pa'i rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyis/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ rigs kyi bu 'di dag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ rnal 'byor chen po'i gral du 'god pa dang / byin rlabs nod par byed pa la/ bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa lus dang grib ma'am/ sha dang rus pa bzhin du gnas pa rnams skad cig yud tsam la 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig gal te mi 'gro ba rnams ye shes kyi khro bo 'bar ba mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pas/ lus rdul bzhin du brlag par 'gyur ta re/ oṃ raṃ kro ta sogs mtshan sngags brjod la/ nyungs kar gyis brabs cing / gu gul gyis dud pa dang / rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing / de ltar dbang bskur ba la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir bgegs bskrad nas/ rigs nges par bya ba'i phyir/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni skal ba bzang po ste/ /bde ba che la bdag dga' 'o/ /'dun pa nges par bya ba'i phyir/ /des ni khyod la ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar skal ba bzang ngan yod pa yin te/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ rang gi bu la'ang ma chags pa'i/ /nyan thos rang rgyal skal ba ngan/ /zhes gsungs pas/ skal ba dman pa rnal 'byor chen po'i gral du 'jug par mi dbang ba la/ skal ba bzang na dbang ba yin te/

rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ sems can rnams la bde 'dod pas/ /bskal bzang phyag na rdo rje dpal/ /zhes so/ /de yan chad kyis phyi'i 'jug pa 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ gnyis pa nang du 'jug pa ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas phye ba'i las kyi lha gcig gis/ sgo nas nang du bcug par mos pa mdzod la dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa re mdzod/ lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje la 'jur bcug ste yol ba bsal la/ bu khyod tshur shog ci bde bar/ /las spyod rim par 'gro ba dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gzung / /rdzogs pa'i ye shes bde chen la/ /dmigs pa med pa gnas phyir du/ /ser sna spangs pa'i ngang nyid kyis/ /gtong zhing rang sems brtan por gzung / /pad+ma'i rigs kyi dbang sogs sbyin/ /zhes pas nang du bcug nas byams pa tshad med pa shar gyi sgo dang / snying rje tshad med pa lho'i sgo dang / dga' ba tshad med pa nub kyi sgo dang / btang snyoms tshad med pa byang gi sgo nas phyag dang bskor ba bya zhing / slar yang shar sgo nas zhugs te snam bu la gnas par mos pa mdzod/ de yang bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te/ lus kyi bu ma yin yang chos kyi sbrel ba'i bu yin pas/ bu'i nang nas mchog yin no/ /tshur shog ci bde bar zhes pas/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir shog cig pa'o/ /der yong ba la sprel 'chong lta bus mi yong ste/ las spyod rim par 'gro ba dang / /zhes pas/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bar du sems bskyed pa dang / tha ma rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba sogs rim par yong dgos so/ /'dir sleb nas kyang sdom pa la gces spras dgos te/ rdo rje slob dpon spyi bo'i gtsug dang mi 'bral zhing / yi dam gyi lha rgyun du sgom pa sku'i dam tshig slob dpon gyi bstod tshigs dang mi 'bral zhing / snying po rgyun du bgrang ba gsung gi dam tshig rdo rje slob dpon la mos gus gdung sems dang mi 'bral zhing de'i thugs dang yi dam gyi thugs/

rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems gsum gsal stong du 'jog pa thugs kyi dam tshig ste/ de gsum dang ma bral bar gyis shig pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don te/ de ltar nang du bcug nas slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i dbang gzhung las/ dgos pa gsum gyi lus dbul bya/ /gnas gsum dbang sbyin mchod pas mchod/ /nyes dmigs sgo nas mna' chu dang / /phan yon sgo nas bdud rtsi byin/ /gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag /ye shes dbab phyir gsol ba gdab/ /lus bcos dbang chen bstim zhing dbab/ /su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan par byas/ /me tog gtor la gsang mtshan btags/ /dkyil 'khor bstan cing lha bsgom dang / /sngags bzlas rjes gnang gsang bar gdams/ /thal sbyar gus dang bcas pa yis/ /phyogs bcu sras dang bcas pa dang / /dbang chu sangs rgyas da lta bdag /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas rang bzhin la/ /dgos pa gsum phyir lus dbul bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ sangs rgyas la lus phul bas gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i dgos pa yod lags pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha pu dza u paṣ+ṭha na ya āta ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ bla ma la lus phul bas rang gi dbang thob cing gzhan la dbang bskur bas chog pa'i dgos pa yod lags pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra a tsar+ya pu dza u paṣ+ṭha na ya āta ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sems can la lus sbyin pas/ gdul bya sbyangs pa can dang 'phrad pa'i dgos pa yod pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a ka la satwa pu dza u paṣ+ṭha na ya āta ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ de ltar lus phul nas gnas gsum gyi dbang sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas 'od 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du phog pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag gser zhun ma'am dngul chu ltar zhu ste hrīḥzhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa tsan+dan gyi be con nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing /

g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra/ ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu/ rngog dmar po/ phuṃ phuṃ ser po/ zhur dkar po/ rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog bzhin pa dang bcas pa/ byi ru bcag pa'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ mgrin par pad+ma/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ spyi bor haṃ ljang gu/ 'od zer 'phro ba haṃ de nyid zhu zhing lus la thim pas rdo rje'i zhun khrab kyis gtams pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ ka ba tsi badz+ra rak+ṣa zhes brjod cing mgo bor rdo rje bzhag pas bsrungs/ sku'i dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa/ /sku yi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i dpral ba'i sku rdo rje las mar me gcig las gnyis chad pa'i tshul du/ sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa gcig phye ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i zla gdan gyi steng du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dpral bar rdo rje bzhag ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed skur bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis rlabs nas kyang / /sku yi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /ka ya sid+dhi oṃ/ sku'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i dam tshig tu rang nyid kyang pad+ma dbang chen/ lus la gnas pa'i srin po'i rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yang yi dam/ snang ba thams cad lhar bsgom dgos so/ /gsung gi dbang gi phyir/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dpal ldan rdo rje gsung 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas gsung 'dzin pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje las gsung rdo rje pad+ma dang / dril bu 'dzin pa gcig phye ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i steng du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mgrin par rdo rje bzhag ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsung bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis rlabs nas kyang / /gsung gi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /waka sid+dhi āḥ gsung gi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i dam tshig tu 'byung ba'i sgra ci smra ci brjod/ sngags sgra la sogs pa yi dam gyi snying por bsgom dgos so/ /thugs kyi dbang gi ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas thugs 'dzin pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /bla ma'i thugs rdo rje las thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gcig phye ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan/ /deng bdag byin gyis rlabs nas kyang / /thugs kyi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ thugs kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i dam tshig tu rang gi ci rgyu ci dran thams cad thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i lha'i thugs yin snyam du bsgom dgos so/ /de ltar tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum dag nas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid mchod pa'i 'os yin te/ dper na zla ba nya ba la tshes mi zer bar/ tshes gcig gam gnyis la zer ba bzhin/ 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ zla ba tshes pa la phyag bya'i/

nya ba la ma yin no/ /de bzhin du gang dang gang la dad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la phyag bya yi/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de nyid la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /zhes sogs sam yang na/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal zhu rtog sgra/ /zhal zas dri mchog 'di rnams kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ rol chen bya'o/ /de nas nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ las bum gyi chu byin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na bsreg par byed/ /rdo rje khro bo chen por 'gyur/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu thungs shig /oṃ badz+ra u tha ka hūm̐/ de ring phyin chad dam tshig ma nyams par gyis shig gal te dam tshig nyams par gyur na/ chu 'di nyid dmyal ba'i khro chur gyur to/ /phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ bdud rtsi byin te/ de lta bas na bu khyod kyis/ /dam tshig 'di ni bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'byung / /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu thungs shig /oṃ badz+ra u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes bdud rtsi lce la bzhag dam tshig bsrung bar gyur na/ bdud rtsi 'di nyid ye shes kyi khro bo dbang chen du gyur nas/ 'di dang phyi ma'i 'dren pa byed par 'gyur zhing / rigs 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsang bar gdams pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'di/ /dam nyams ma 'dres med pa la/ /nam yang smra bar mi bya 'o/ /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/

de yang 'di lta bu'i dbang dang sgrub thabs zab mo 'di dam nyams kho nar gyur pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ theg pa chen po ston byed pa'i/ /nga la brnyas dang smad mi bya/ /sku gsung thugs su rtag gnas nas/ /ma lus sems can don gyis shig /bla ma'i bka' mnyan pas nga la yang brnyas pa byar mi rung zhing / ngas ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bya dgos so/ /zhes dam la bzhag nas/ ye shes dbab pa'i phyir du bla ma la mos gus brtan po dang ldan pas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes dang / maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi'i ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal pad+ma dbang chen bdag la dbab tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas khyed rang rnams kyis dngos su bya ba'am bsam kyang rung ste/ hob langs te/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ g.yang lugs shus rting pa btegs te rkang pa'i brang la lus kyi lcid yong bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sngar bsgom pa ltar gyi dbang chen du gsal ba'i ngang las 'og min nam/ bde ba can nas/ khro bo dbang chen byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam dpag tu med pa steng nas char bzhin du babs/ 'og nas na bun ltar 'khrigs/ phyogs bcu nas kha ba bu yug tshub pa ltar byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig

ces brjod la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing / ḍā dril rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas la/ oṃ e hā hi bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha ho/ sa ma ya dzaḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra dz+nyā na ā be sha ya āḥ zhes brjod do/ /yang 'og min nam/ bde ba can nas hrīḥ badz+ra kro dha ha yaṃ gṛ wa hū lu hū lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyi yi ge sgra dang bcas pa mgrin pa'i gnas su thim pa'i dmigs pa mdzod cig ces brjod la sngar ltar rol mo bya'o/ /yang phyi nang chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa dang bral ba'i ngang las rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu rang bzhin med par shes pa'i rtogs pa brtan por bskyed la/ blo lhod glod la ma yengs pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog par zhu zhes brjod/ ye shes babs pa'i rtags ni/ rta mchog rol pa las/ sku yi ye shes phyogs bcur g.yo/ /gsung gi ye shes sngags brjod cing / /thugs kyi ye shes mngon shes gsal/ /zhes pa ltar ye shes dbab pa'i rtags ci rigs pa 'byung bas na phag snying 'dod pa'am/ smra snying 'dod pa'am/ rgod snying 'dod pa la sogs pa ci byung ched du mi sgrub/ ched du mi 'gegs/ shes pa rten med du bzhag go /de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ de ltar brtan par byas nas/ me tog dor ba ni/ srin lag la dkris pa'i me tog rnams sor mo sbug mor bshib pa'i nang du bcug ste/ rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'ongs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu'i gtsug tu phul bar mos par mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ me tog la sogs rin chen phreng / /sngon tshe ye shes brnyes pa'i lha/ /thugs kyis gnang bar dgongs nas kyang / /gang yin de la dbab tu gsol/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ me tog dor te byin gyis rlabs pa'i phyir/

me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta/ mig gnyis su/ oṃ re re bsgom mdzod/ oṃ/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /khyod kyi mig 'byed rtsom par mdzad/ /ma rig sgrib pa bsal byas nas/ /pad+ma'i spyan bzang dri ma med/ /oṃ pad+ma tsak+ṣu dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭa/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs dbye/ me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi gsang mtshan btags te/ skyes pa bud med kyi bye brag gis/ pad+ma rgyal po rtsal/ pad+ma dbyings phyug rtsal/ zhes sogs btags la khyed rnams kyi ming la deng phyin chad 'di dang 'di bya ba yin no zhes brjod/ ngos su dor zhing so so la phog pa yin na 'di bzhin dang / 'bul ba'i stangs ka dang gtso bo yab yum la phog pa'i mos pa byas pa yin na ming gnyis po de kho na btags so/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ bla ma'i phyag tu dbyug tho'am rdo rje bzung la/ legs par ltos shig blo gros che/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba la sogs pa/ /gsang sngags gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /legs par zhugs te grub pa yin/ /me tog gang la phog pa yi/ /lha de rigs kyi yi dam yin/ /gzhal yas gru bzhir 'byung ba ni/ /tshad med bzhi rnams dag pa'i rtags/ /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /drwa ba drwa phyed brgyan pa ni/ /nyon mongs che chung rnam dag go /ka ba brgyad kyis dbur brgyan pa/ /'phags lam brgyad po rnam dag rtags/ /rin chen pha gu la sogs rgyan/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags/ /'dod pa'i lha mos rgyan pa ni/ /gzugs sgra dri ro rnam dag rtags/ /rdo rje rwa bas bskor ba ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtags/ /ri dwags sha ras brgyan pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpas bskor ba'i rtags/ /rin chen lnga las 'grub pa ni/ /nyon mongs lnga rnams dag pa dang / /ye shes lnga las grub pa'i rtags/ /thod pa'i phreng bas bskor ba ni/

/nga dang bdag 'dzin bral ba'i rtags/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang sa'i khams rnam par dag cing byams pa tshad med pa'i sgo nas zhi ba'i las mdzad pa ni/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ chu'i khams rnam par dag cing snying rje tshad med pa'i sgo nas rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa ni/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma/ me'i khams rnam par dag cing dga' ba tshad med pa'i sgo nas dbang gi las mdzad pa ni/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ rlung gi khams rnam par dag cing btang snyoms tshad med pa'i sgo nas drag po'i las mdzad pa ni/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma/ gzugs kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa gti mug gnas su dag cing / me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo shar rtsibs la rdo rje dbang chen/ tshor ba'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna gnas su dag cing / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo lho rtsibs la rin chen dbang chen/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa 'dod chags gnas su dag cing / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nub rtsibs la pad+ma dbang chen/ 'du byed kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa phrag dog gnas su dag cing / bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo byang rtsibs la phrin las dbang chen/ 'dod chags rnam par dag cing dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes kyi ngo bo sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa ni yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ rnam shes kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gnas su dag cing / chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo gtso bo bcom ldan 'das pad+ma rta mchog dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba yin te/ de rnams kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba gcig nyid kyi cho 'phrul yin pas na bzang ngan la sogs pa gang yang med mod/ 'on kyang khyod kyi skye ba snga ma'i lha bskal me tog phog pa'i lha ni bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid do/ /zhes sogs yi dam gang yin ngos bstan no/ /lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ni/

bdag nyid lha dang mnyam sbyor na/ /yon tan chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /lha spangs dge spyod don med yin/ /dad med rnams ni phung par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'thon/ khyed rang rnams dbang chen du gsal ba'i snying gar sngags phreng 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya gṛ ba sogs lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug de nas gzhan la gsang bar gdams pa dang rjes gnang ni/ gsang ba snying po las/ gsang sngags gsang zhes bya ba ni/ /chos la skyon yod ma yin te/ /blo chung theg pa dman la gsang / /skal ldan rnams kyi sman yin te/ /skal med rnams la dug tu 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rtag tu gos pa med gyis la/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod/ /bya 'am mi bya cung zad med/ /sems ni theg par rab nges na/ /nyon mongs 'dod pa kun spyod kyang / /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin du/ /tshul khrims sdom pa phun sum tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems bskyed rdzogs zab mo dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'dod yon lnga la longs spyad kyang nyon mongs pas ma gos pa rjes su gnang zhing snod ma yin pa rnams la gsang bar gdams pa'o/ /de yan chad kyis 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i dbang gzhung las/ dbang la rnam pa gsum yin te/ /yon dbul gsol btab dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po yon dbul ba ni/ gsang ba snying po las/ rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces pa'i yid 'thad dbul/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/

bla ma dang pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa la sku bum pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyis pa gsol ba btab pa ni/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ a la la ste dam tshig skong / /a la la ste dngos grub stsol/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang drang ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon pad+mas dbang gzhung las/ dbang bskur rnam pa bzhi po ni/ /khrag 'thung lha lnga'i bum dbang sbyin/ /ngag smin bya phyir gsang dbang bskur/ /yid smin shes rab ye shes dbang / /bzhi pa brjod du med pa ste/ /tshig tsam gyis ni bskur bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ bum dbang lus la bskur ba lha yi dbang / gsang dbang ngag la bskur ba sngags kyi dbang / shes rab ye shes sems la bskur ba chos kyi dbang / bzhi pa lus ngag yid gsum la bskur ba bde ba chen po'i dbang ngo / /dang po ni/ khrag 'thung lha lnga'i bum dbang sbyin/ /mthu rtsal bskyed phyir lha dbang bskur/ /rjes gnang dur khrod chas brgyad sbyin/ /brtan byed gtor ma'i dbang dang bzhi/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po khrag 'thung lha lnga'i bum dbang sbyin pa'i rdzas ni/ khrag 'thung lha dgu zhu ba las byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis bskur ba yin la/ bskur mkhan ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad kyis bskur/ bskur ba ni slob ma'i gnas lngar bskur ba byed pa lags/ de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba la phan yon ji tsam yod snyam na/ sku lnga ye shes lnga/ rigs lnga la sogs pa'i go 'phang thob pa la/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma sbyong ba la/ lam bsgom pa la dngos grub kyi skal ba ster ba la mchog bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la 'jog pa la dbang ba'i phyir/

dbang zhes gsung ngo / /yang / phyi rol nyid dang nang dang ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bsre ba dang / /sku bzhi'i sa bon gdab pa'i phyir/ /rgyud kun la ni dbang rab bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la dbang rnam pa gcig bskur nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam tshul bzhin du bsgom na/ rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas par gsungs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'di yi chos kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtshos rnam par brgyan/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /'bring nas bar dor 'grub gsungs te/ /yang na lus 'di spangs ma thag /brtson pa mi ldan pas kyang 'grub/ /ces gsungs/ tha mas kyang skye ba bdun nas 'grub par gsungs te/ gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun na ni/ /ma bsgoms par yang dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs/ shin tu tha mas kyang skye ba bcu drug nas 'grub par gsungs te/ slob dpon pad+mas dam tshig lnga pa las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag la 'grub/ /ces gsungs pas phan yon de lta bu yod pa lags/ dbang ma thob pa la nyes dmigs ji tsam yod bsam na/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ dper na pi waṃ sbyor tshogs kun/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi nus/ /de bzhin dbang bskur med pa la/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces sogs nyes pa'ang mang du gsungs pas/ dbang la nan tan bskyed dgos par gsungs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan bum dbang lus la bskur nas lus kyi dri ma sbyangs pas/ lus sprul pa'i skur ston cing de nyid thob pa'i dgos pa yod/ gsang dbang ngag la bskur nas ngag gi dri ma sbyangs pas ngag longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur byin gyis rlob cing / de nyid thob pa'i dgos pa yod/ shes rab ye shes sems la bskur nas/ sems kyi dri ma sbyangs pas/

sems chos skur byin gyis rlob cing de nyid thob pa'i dgos pa yod/ tshig dbang sgo gsum ka la bskur nas/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs pas rlung ngo bo nyid skur byin gyis rlob cing / de nyid thob pa'i dgos pa la sogs pa mang du yod pas dang po bum dbang bskur ba lha'i dbang ni/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad pas bum pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / /rdo rje rigs kyi dbang bskur bas/ /dbang bskur dam pa chen po sbyin/ /hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis bum pa'i chu blugs pas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas zhe sdang gis bskyed pa'i sdig sgrib dang gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang zhe sdang gnas gyur/ lus zag pa med pa'i chu rgyun gyis khengs te/ lus dbang chen du gsal bar byas/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo badz+ra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbur brgyan/ yang bum pa dpral bar bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /'khor lo gsang ba gsum las byung / /'khor lo rigs kyi dbang bskur bas/ /dbang bskur dam pa chen po sbyin/ /oṃ bud+dha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chu blugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas gti mug gis bskyed pa'i sdig sgrib dang gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po dang gti mug gnas gyur/ lus zag pa med pa'i chu rgyun gyis khengs te/ lus dbang chen du gsal bar byas/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bud+dha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbur brgyan/ bum pa rna ltag g.yas su bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/

/rin chen gsang ba gsum las byung / /rin chen rigs kyi dbang bskur bas/ /dbang bskur dam pa chen po sbyin/ /swā rat+na he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chu blugs pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas nga rgyal gyis bskyed pa'i sdig sgrib dang / gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po dang nga rgyal gnas 'gyur/ lus zag med kyi chu rgyun gyis khengs te/ lus dbang chen du gsal bar byas/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rat+na he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbur brgyan/ bum pa ltag par bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /pad+ma gsang ba gsum las byung / /pad+ma rigs kyi dbang bskur bas/ /dbang bskur dam pa chen po sbyin/ /āḥpad+ma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chu blugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'dod chags kyis bskyed pa'i sdig sgrib dang gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang 'dod chags gnas gyur/ lus zag med kyi chu rgyun gyis khengs te/ lus dbang chen du gsal bar byas/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo pad+ma he ru ka dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbur brgyan/ bum pa rna ltag g.yon du bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /las kyi gsang ba gsum las byung / /las kyi rigs kyi dbang bskur bas/ /dbang bskur dam pa chen po sbyin/ /hā karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa'i chu blugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas phrag dog gis bskyed pa'i sdig sgrib dang gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po dang phrag dog gnas gyur/ lus zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khengs te/ lus dbang chen du gsal bar byas/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo karma he ru ka ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbur brgyan/

dbang de'i mtha' rten rjes su gnang ba ni/ rta mgrin dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud las/ slob ma 'jug pa'i las rdzogs nas/ /bum pas dbang bskur dri ma bkru/ /dur khrod chas brgyad dbang bskur la/ /khro bo'i rtags gdab lha dbang bskur/ /zhes dang / bai ros/ lha brgyad dur khrod chas brgyad sbyin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnyis pa mthu rtsal bskyed cing lha dbang lus la bskur ba ni/ gu ru rin po che pad+ma'i tsa ka li khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ dkyil 'khor 'di'i bdag po rgyal tshab spyi'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje 'dzin/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /sku gsum bdag nyid gu ru'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la bla mas dbang bskur bas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig yab yum gyi tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /yum chen pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hu lū hu lū hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dpal chen yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas zhe sdang dang 'dod chags rnam par dag nas bde stong zung du 'jug pa dpal chen yab yum gyi dbang thob par gyur cig rdo rje dbang chen gyi tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng du/ /rdo rje dbang chen dkar po khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /zhe sdang 'dul phyir me long dbang bskur ro/

/oṃ badz+ra shwa ra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam kyi lhas/ skal ldan skyes bu khyod la rdo rje dbang chen gyi dbang bskur bas zhe sdang rnam par dag nas me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du gyur te/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig rin chen dbang chen gyi tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ lho phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng du/ /rin chen dbang chen ser nag khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /nga rgyal 'dul phyir mnyam nyid dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ rat+na shwa ra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la rin chen dbang chen gyi dbang bskur bas nga rgyal rnam par dag nas mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du gyur te mngon par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig pad+ma dbang chen gyi tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ nub phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng du/ /pad+ma dbang chen dmar smug khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /'dod chags 'joms phyir sor rtog dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ pad+ma shwa ra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la pad+ma dbang chen gyi dbang bskur bas/ 'dod chags rnam par dag nas/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur te mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'phrin las dbang chen gyi tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng du/ /'phrin las dbang chen ljang nag khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /phrag dog 'joms phyir bya grub dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ karma shwa ra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la phrin las dbang chen gyi dbang bskur bas/ phrag dog rnam par dag nas/ bya grub ye shes mngon du gyur te mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig

sgo ma lcags kyu ma'i tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs dung gi sgo khyud nas/ /sgo ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin/ /rkyen dang bar chad zhi ba'i lha/ /byams pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ a bhi ṣañtsi maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sgo ma lcags kyu ma'i dbang bskur bas/ byams pa tshad med pa mngon du gyur nas rkyen dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig sgo ma zhags pa ma'i tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ lho phyogs gser gyi sgo khyud nas/ /sgo ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i lha/ /snying rje chen po'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra pa sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sgo ma zhags pa mas dbang bskur bas/ snying rje tshad med pa mngon du gyur nas/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig sgo ma lcags sgrog ma'i tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ nub phyogs zangs kyi sgo khyud nas/ /sgo ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin/ /thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i lha/ /dga' ba chen po'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sgo ma lcags sgrog mas dbang bskur bas/ dga' ba tshad med pa mngon du gyur nas snang srid thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig sgo ma dril bu ma'i tsa ka li thogs la/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs g.yu yi sgo khyud nas/ /sgo ma ljang khu dril bu 'dzin/ /dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol ba'i lha/ /btang snyoms chen po'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sgo ma dril bu ma'i dbang bskur bas/ btang snyoms tshad med pa mngon du gyur nas/ dgra bgegs thams cad dbyings su sgrol ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig

gsum pa rjes gnang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad la/ chos sku mtshon pa thal chen tshom bu'i dbang / /longs sku mtshon pa rak+ta'i thig le'i dbang / /sprul sku mtshon pa zhag chen zo ris dbang / /sku gsum mtshon pa thod pa rgyan gyi dbang / /dbang du sdud pa sbrul chen rigs lnga'i dbang / /thabs la mkhas pa zhing chen lpags pa'i dbang / /gti mug 'joms pa glang chen lpags pa'i dbang / /phrag dog 'joms pa gsang sgo stag lpags dbang / /zhes pa ltar rim pa bzhin du bskur ba las/ de yang 'dod pa'i khams su ru tra sde gsum gyis 'jig rten ma rungs par byas pa la/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang / zhal bcu gcig phyag stong la sogs par sprul nas btul yang ma thul ba las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin 'di nyid kyis dbang du sdud cing / dpal chen po badz+ra he ru ka zhes bya ba/ thugs rje che la thabs mkhas pa des dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par sprul nas ru tra sde gsum ka kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum kas bsgral te/ khog pa dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang du byas/ khrag chen zhal du gsol bas/ mkhur tshos g.yas g.yon sna rtse rak+ta'i thig le zla ba tshes pa lta bu chags/ zhag chen zhal du gsol bas thugs kar zhag gi zo ris chags/ rus chen zhal du gsol bas dpral bar thal chen tshom bu chags/ de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i glang chen smyon pa bsgral ba'i pags pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa sku bstod la gsol/ dred smyon bsgral ba'i g.yang gzhi mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa g.yang lugs kyi tshul du stod la gsol/ stag gtum po bsgral ba'i pags pa sku smad la sham thabs su gsol nas/ dbang bskur ba'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs nas steng gdon gza' dang / 'og gdon klu dang / bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad rnams dbang du bsdus shing tshar bcad pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis dbang bskur bar byed pa la/

byug pa'i rdzas gsum/ bgo ba'i gos gsum/ 'dogs pa'i rgyan gsum rnams kyis mnga' gsol zhing dbang bskur bar byed pa yin te/ khyed rang rnams dbang chen gyi skur gsal ba la/ bla mas dur khrod chas brgyad gnang bas sku la bsnams shing mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dang po thal chen tshom bu'i dbang ni/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /pho nya kun dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /thal chen tshom bus brgyan pa yang / /'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgya 'o/ /'di yang sngon gyi tha tshig go /'di yang dur khrod chen po'i dbang / /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /thal chen tshom bus slob ma'i dpral bar kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i dbyibs bris/ longs sku mtshon pa rak+ta'i thig le'i dbang ni/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /ma mo kun dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /rak+ta'i thig les brgyan pa yang / /'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgya 'o/ /'di yang sngon gyi tha tshig go /'di yang dur khrod chen po'i dbang / /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /slob ma'i mkhur tshos g.yas g.yon gnyis sna rtse gsum la rak+ta'i thig le thod pa tshal bu'i dbyibs su bri'o/ /sprul sku mtshon pa zhag gi zo ris kyi dbang ni/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /gying chen kun dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /zhag gi zo ris brgyan pa yang / /'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgya 'o/ /'di yang sngon gyi tha tshig go /'di yang dur khrod chen po'i dbang / /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /slob ma'i snying gar zhag gi zo ris rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbyibs su bris/ de rnams byug pa'i rdzas gsum gyi dbang bskur ba lags/ bgo ba'i gos gsum gyi dbang bskur ba la/ thabs la mkhas pa zhing chen lpags pa'i dbang ni/ zhing lpags sku la gsol ba dur khrod rgyan/ /g.yang gzhi tshe 'u sug sdom sku la bcings/ /'khor ba ma spangs gnas su dag pa yis/

/dur khrod tshogs kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhis khyed la dbang bskur bas/ /zhing rlon thabs la mkhas pa 'di nyid kyis/ /'khor ba'i gnas las thar pa'i dbang thob shog /oṃ na ra tha wasatra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhing mgo g.yon du bstan pa rgyab tu bskon te snying gar mdud pa bya'o/ /gti mug 'joms pa glang chen lpags pa'i dbang ni/ glang chen ko rlon brjid du che ba yis/ /gti mug ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i rgyan/ /na bza' rgyan gyis sku la mnga' gsol zhing / /thabs kyi ko rlon rgyan gyi dam pa yis/ /gang la dmigs pa'i dbang chen 'di bskur bas/ /stobs kyi rgyal po'i dbang mchog thob par shog /oṃ ma hā ti ra wasatra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ glang mgo g.yas su bstan pa slob ma'i rgyab tu bskon zhing snying gar mdud pa bcings/ phrag dog 'joms pa gsang sgo stag lpags kyi dbang ni/ zhe sdang drag po stag gi sham thabs 'di/ /stag pags sham thabs dpa' bar ldan pa yin/ /sug pa 'doms snol phyi gnang gsang bar bcings/ /phrag dog 'joms pa stag lpags dbang bskur bas/ /zhe sdang gnas 'joms phrag dog kun rgyal ba'i/ /dbang mchog dam pa gnas 'dir thob par shog /oṃ byā gh+ra wasatra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ stag gi sham thabs kyis smad g.yogs so/ /de gsum ni bgo ba'i gos gsum gyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /sku gsum mtshon pa thod pa rgyan gyi dbang ni/ dung chen khong seng dbang po lnga dang ldan/ /sku gsum tshul 'chags skam rlon rid pa'i tshul/ /'khor ba gnas su sdud pa phreng ba'i rgyan/ /khams gsum thogs med phreng bas dbang bskur bas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog thob par shog /oṃ bhan+dha ka pā la dha sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ thod pa skam rlon gyi phreng bas slob ma'i lus la brgyan no/ /dbang du sdud pa sbrul chen rigs lnga'i dbang ni/ thod sbrul gnyen lcug 'jigs byed rgyan du che/ /sbrul nag stong gis brgyan pa'i rngam brjid can/

/sku la mchod phyir sku yi rgyan du 'khyil/ /dug lnga ma spangs dbang gi thabs su bstan/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem zhe sdang drag po 'joms/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyi klu brgyad dbang du sdud/ /zhe sdang 'dul ba'i dbang phyug yin pa'i phyir/ /sbrul nag chun pos khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /zhe sdang drag po 'bar ba gnas dag nas/ /thabs mkhas rgyal po mnyes pa'i dbang thob shog /oṃ na ga rā dza a laṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ slob ma'i yan lag sbrul nag chun pos brgyan no/ /de gsum ni 'dogs byed rgyan gsum gyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /de ltar dpal gyi chas su bzhugs pa la dgos pa gsum yod de/ dper na mi dpa' bo go cha stabs nas dgra bo tshar gcod pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa dpal gyi chas su bzhugs pas bgegs zil gyis gnon cing tshar gcod pa dang / dmag stong dpon mang pos 'gran pa'i tshe rang rang gi dpon pos ru mtshon 'phyar bas ngo shes pa bzhin/ rnal 'byor pa dpal gyi chas su zhugs pas/ ma mo mkha' 'gros jo jo ltar ngo shes pa'i dgos pa dang / rgyal po'i phyag rtags tshogs pa la sogs kyis khyer phyin pas gzhan gyis 'joms mi nus pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa dpal gyi chas su zhugs pas bdud dang srin po sogs zil gyis gnon cing / bar chad mi nus pa'i dgos pa yod pas/ mdor na tha mal gyi rtog pa brtul nas khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i nga rgyal la bzhugs shing / dbang chen gyi khyer so gsum bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don no/ /bzhi pa mthu stsal bskyed pa gtor ma'i dbang la/ gsol ba gdab pa/ gtor ma sgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba'o/ /de yang gtor ma zhes bya ba'i don ni/ phyogs 'dod kyi zhen pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ gzung 'dzin dang phyogs ris med par stong bas na gtor ma zhes bya'o/ /'di nyid byin gyis rlob dus dang / mchod par 'bul dus/ 'dod yon drug gi lha mo mkha' khyab tu bsam/

dbang bskur dus dang / tshogs 'bul dus yi dam gyi lha tshogs su bsam/ dngos grub len dus rā dza rgyal por bsam/ gtor bzlog byed dus dug gi sdong po dang / mtshon cha sogs su gsal ba dang / lhag ma gtong dus rin po che'i mchod sdong du gsal bar gtong bas na/ de'i phyir kun bzang bdun bshags las/ rnam grangs bdun gsungs te/ rnam tog gi gtor ma/ chos nyid kyi gtor ma/ gzung 'dzin gyiྎ yo byad kyiྎ srog dbugs kyiྎ thig le'iྎ sha khrag gi gtor ma'o/ /dang po gsol ba btab pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la gtor dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ khro rgyal rngam chen rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /gnyis pa gtor ma sgrub pa ni/ raṃ kro tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phyi dpal gtor gyi rnam pa la/ nang dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ dbus dmar nag gru gsum zla gam dmar po gsum dang bcas pa thod pa skam rlon gyi rtsig pa 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ dur khrod rdo rje'i rwa ba me ris dang bcas pa phyi gsal nang gsal ye shes kyi snang ba can du gyur pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i steng du/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal/ mahā sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ dbus su ru tra baṃ/ shar du de ba baṃ/ lhor pa ma baṃ/ nub tu na ga baṃ/ byang du ya sha baṃ/ sgo bzhir a tsaṇ+ḍa baṃ/ hūm̐/ ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas chen po/ /'khor lo dbang chen pho brang ldan/ /phyi nang med pa yongs su gsal/ /hrīḥmaṃḥs+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha yaṃ gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka oṃ bud+dha he ru ka

swā rat+na he ru ka āḥpad+ma he ru ka hā karma he ru ka oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ saṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na kro ta shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma kro ta shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karma kro ta shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ gdan bting sku bskyed dbang bskur zhing / /byin gyis brlabs pa rab tu bya/ /yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gsal/ /bdag mdun gnyis ka'i snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nub phyogs pad+ma dbang chen gyi gzhal yas nas bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ 'khor bza' byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ mahā pad+ma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ mahā pad+ma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ yang na sh+lau ka re re'i mtshams su dril bu bcad gtub tu bsil zhing / hrīḥ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /zag med bde chen rnam 'phrul sku/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros pa kun las rnam grol yang / /chags can chags pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /bud med sgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cing / /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag chad bdag mtshan rnam dag cing / /bsdu dngos tshad med bzhi yi dngos/ /dgug gzhug bcings dang dbang mdzad pa/ /sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rab khros rngams shing mi zad pa/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/

/bka' bsdod rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing / /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /sa gzhi rwa ba bla re gur/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can/ /srung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod la bstod pa'i dge ba des/ /lam gyi bar chad bgegs bsal nas/ /tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ /sku bzhi bdag nyid thob par shog /rang gi snying kha'i hriḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bde bar gshegs pa yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas/ gtor ma la babs pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ pad+ma ta kri pad+ma shwa ra mahā kro ta ha yaṃ gṛ wa ma ma rak+mo dun+ti hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ pad+ma kro ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a la la hoḥ nyer gcig gam bdun gyis bdud rtsir sgrub/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rngam klongs las/ ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur te/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlob/ /ces pa ltar gtor ma dbang chen rten dang brten par bcas pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rmad du byung ba dpal gyi gtor ma 'di/ /dbang chen lha tshogs thugs dam bskang ba dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can mchod pa'i phyir/ /skal ldan slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /rmad byung mchod pa'i gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas/ /dam can 'du zhing mthu rtsal che bar shog /mahā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ khā hi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ nyid cag rang rnams pad+ma dbang chen du gsal bar byas pa'i spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar/ gtor ma dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang / lha dgu dang bcas par bskyed par de nyid sib sib thim pas/

rang rang gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam par dmar krong nge yod pa'i dbus su byon/ lus thams cad 'od dmar pos khengs/ mthu dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ slar snying kha'i lha dgu po 'od kyi rnam par zhu ste me long la has btab pa yal ba ltar 'dus nas/ rang rang gi snying kha na ye shes sems dpa' zhes bya ba/ hrīḥdamar po re yod pa la thim/ de'i mtha' mar hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha yaṃ gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa lu gu brgyud kyis bsdams te bskal pa dus mtha'i mes kyang mi tshugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pas/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bya ba byang chub pa'i bya ba mtha' dag sa kun tu 'od dang stug po bkod/ bde ba dga' ba/ lta ba snang stong / 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa sogs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /gsang dbang ngag la bskur ba sngags dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rdo rje slob dpon pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i pang du yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma gnas pa hūm̐ bam̐ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs pa las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ badz+ra/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la es mtshan pa/ e aṃ/ a nu ra ko ya haṃ/ a nu ra ko ya mi/ bo dhi tsit+ta sid+dhi ku ru hūm̐/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dkar po khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/

dngos su sngar gyi bdud rtsi lce thog dang gtor ma mgrin par bzhag la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brjod/ gsang ba thabs dang shes rab las/ /pad+ma nor bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /dges pa chen po'i bde chen dang / /byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur ro/ /pad+ma su kha bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar gtor ma mgrin par bzhag pas/ gsung rnam dag 'od dpag med gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag gtum po'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / bde ba mchog dga'/ sa pad+ma can/ lta ba rig stong / 'bras bu longs sku thob pa sogs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /shes rab ye shes sems la bskur ba'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba 'di nas/ brlab tu gsol gyi bar brjod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bla mas bu mo mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa gcig khyed rang rnams kyi lag par gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bzung ma 'di ni yid 'ong ma/ /bsten byar rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /khro mo yum du dran byas nas/ /'khor lo rim pa'i bde ba myongs/ /zhes byin pa des khyed rang rnams la dri ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sha chen bshang gci sogs dang ni/ /gtsog za la sogs pad+mar 'o/ /bu khyod spro na phyag rgya yi/ /dngos grub dam pa bdag las 'byung / /de ltar dris pa la khyed rang rnams kyis lan btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsang sngags dngos grub mnyam med pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi sbyor las byung / /ji ltar cho ga bzhin gsungs pa/ /thams cad spro 'o lha mo che/ /zhes lan btab pas pang du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen dang / yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug mar gsal la hūm̐ baṃ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

hūm̐ badz+ra/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la es mtshan pa/ ye shes sngon du bya bsam pas/ bsrub pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba rus sbal gyi 'gros ltar mkhas par byas la/ mas bstan gyi dga' ba bzhi'am/ skad cig gi dga' ba bzhi dang / rlung gi nus pas yar zlog nas lus kun la bkram zhing byer ba'o/ /gtor ma snying gar bzhag la gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brjod/ de ltar na gtor ma snying gar bzhag pas/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba dang / ye shes khyad par can gyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag mgyogs byed pho nya bsgom pa la dbang / bde ba la dga' bral/ sa ye shes bla ma/ 'khor lo tshogs chen dang / lta ba bde stong / 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa lus ngag yid gsum mtha' dag la bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab nas ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar brjod la/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bla mas slob ma la me long bstan nas me long nang du shar ba kun rdzob dang mtshungs la/ gzugs de la brtags na phyi nang gang du'ang ma grub/ snang ba'i phyir med pa ma yin/ btsal na gang na yang med pas/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mtha' thams cad dang bral bas/ rdzogs pa chen por brjod du med pa ni gsum pa'i yum gyi khams rtsa rlung gsum gcig tu 'dres pa brjod bral gyi ye shes de nyid la ngo sprod pa yin te/ mu tig dkar dang tsan+dan smug /nam mkha'i khams su 'dres pa las/ /rtog med mnyam nyid chos kyi sku/ /zung du med pa 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /med pa ma yin snying po'i don/ /yod med gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag yin/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gtor ma lte bar bzhag la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brjod/ de ltar na gtor ma lte bar bzhag pas/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum mtha' dag gi dri ma dag a ti yo ga bsgom pa la dbang / bde ba lhan skyes/ lta ba mtha' bral/ sa ye shes bla ma/ sku don dam rdo rje'i sku dang / ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /de nas 'chi med tshe'i mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ 'dir theg pa rim pa dgu las/ skyed pa mahā yo ga'i chos skor/ de la sgrub sde chen po brgyad yod pa las/ pad+ma gsung gi chos skor/ de la yang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi chos skor rnams las/ ches khyad par du 'phags pa nying khu'i bcud phyung ba lta bu yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub sgrub par byed pa la/ phyi zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa dang / nang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i lugs yin no/ /de yang o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ grub pa mchog gi dbang po dpal ldan 'dar phyar la/ nags rgyal ri bo'i ngogs su zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ 'di nyid kyi dbang dang gdams pa yongs su rdzogs par gnang ba de nyid nas bzung ste dus deng sang gi bar du bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la tshig dang don gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' babs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa lags/ de lta bu'i tshe'i dbang bskur ba sgrub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ rab rlung sems la dbang thob cing / yi dam lha'i rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum du ston nus pa/ 'bring byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa/ tha ma'ang 'di'i dbang bskur ba thob cing / cho ga'i lag len la mkhas pa gcig gis sgrub par gsungs/

gang la sgrub pa'i slob ma ni/ bla ma dang chos dang gdams ngag la yid ches pa khyad par 'di nyid la ched du mos pa zhig la sgrub/ dgos pa ni/ tshe nyams pa gsos nas tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i don du sgrub pa yin/ de yang tshe nyams pa'i rgyu ni/ dpal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba tshe'i rgyud las/ dam can sems dkrugs sngags pa yid chad dang / /zhe sdang drag po rbod gtong khar babs dang / /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam nyams dang / /gnas min gnas bcas gyur pa 'di dag ni/ /tshe yar dbugs dngangs bgegs kyi dbang du gyur/ /dgra dbang gyur dang mkha' 'gros gtses/ /rbod gtong khar phyin dus min 'chi/ /tshe nyams pa yi rgyu ru bshad/ /ces gsungs/ rgyu de rnams la brten nas tshe nyams pa'i rtags ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ gzi brjid med dang lus nyams bral/ /mdog nyams bya ba dor ba dang / /yid mi bde dang lci nyams chung / /tshe nyams pa yi rtags su bshad/ /ces dang / yang 'khor la khro zhing sdug skad 'byin pa dang / /bzhin 'gyur spyod lam 'chal par 'gyur ba dang / /slob dpon 'tsho byed dus las g.yel ba dang / /kha zas dag kyang yid khar mi 'ong ba/ /'di dag tshe nyams pa yi rtags su bshad/ /ces gsungs/ de lta bu'i tshe nyams pa'i rtags byung ba'i gang zag gis tshe bsring bar byed pa'i thabs ji snyed bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim pa ni/ slob dpon chen pos tshe yi dbang byang las/ tshe nyams pa las bsrung 'dod pas/ /dbang dang sgrub pa'i dus dag tu/ /maṇ+ḍal dri zhing tshe rdzas bsog /sgrub po nus dang ldan pa yis/ /dbang chen 'phrin las gzhung bsrang zhing / /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ mdun du tshe rten mchod pa sogs kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs par bshams/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis yang gsang khros pa'i phrin las 'dzab bstod kyi bar dang / tshe rten bskyed cing tshe 'gug bcings rten la bsdu ba rnams legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnam pa'i ngo skal du gyur pa'i tshe'i dbang bskur ba sgrub pa la/

thog mar tshe byang las/ tshe la bar chad bgegs rnams bskrad/ /ces gsungs pas/ slob dpon yang gsang khros par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi khro bo mtshon cha thogs shing / sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa/ me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa dpag tu med pa chad/ khyed rang rnams la tshe'i dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad cing tshar bcad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ na mo/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa ste/ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin gyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha tshogs sogs yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyiྎ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams kyiྎ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ bdag cag gi rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la tshe'i dbang bskur ba zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs/ mi min mi ru rdzu ba/ lha min lha ru rdzu ba/ gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa la mi dbang ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas pa rgyang ring du songs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ye shes kyi khro bo rab tu 'bar ba 'di rnams kyis skad cig nyid la rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /oṃ raṃ kro dha sogs mtshams sngags brjod/ gu gul gyi du ba dang rol mo'i sgra chen po bsgrags/ de ltar bgegs bskrad nas/ tshe rten lha ru bskyed bya zhing /

/zhes gsungs pa'i nyams len/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'di nyid na/ tshe rten tshe bum dang bcas pa 'od gsal gyi snang ba las grub pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ pyaṃ dmar po/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus/ pad+ma gaṇ+ḍa/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus/ oṃ a ro lig pyaṃ ra ga ra ti satwaṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum tshe'i lha mo gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bkra shis mda' dar dmar po g.yab tu 'dor ba/ g.yon tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku stod yan chad khebs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin/ zhi ba 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dbu'i gnas lngar rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ zhes pas rin po che'i khang bu lnga'i nang du/ oṃ mahā pra ti bi ṣa dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ mahā a da rna dz+nyā naྎ oṃ mahā sa man+ta dz+nyā naྎ oṃ mahā shu n+yā ta dz+nyā naྎ oṃ mahā kri ta a nu dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas dbus rigs lngar rgyal ba rigs lngas dbur brgyan/

de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs par bsam zhing / thugs rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing / /byams pa'i zhags pas gnas nas spyan yang 'dren/ /lcags sgrog bka' yis pho nyas rab bskyod de/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs shing rnam grol dges par mdzod/ /oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi ka tri sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / 'chi med tshe'i lha mo tsan+dha li la sogs pa tshe yi rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ lha dang srung ma'i tshogs thams cad phyag na bum pa dang thod pa la sogs pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprin phung 'thib pa ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis 'dzab dbyangs dang shis brjod kyi sgra sgrog bdud rtsi dang me tog gi char 'bebs par bsam mo/ /de dag la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis/ /srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bhe/ sarba tad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga khaṃ gṛh+ne satwaṃ sa ma ya swā hā/ yang dag don du dag mod kyang / /'gro ba yongs kyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang / /rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ a ha ra a ha ra sarba bid dha ra pu dzi te na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ sa mā ye swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥrā ga badz+ra/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+da āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang / oṃ mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/

zhes pas bdud rtsi dbul/ de ltar lha gsal btab cing mchod pa'i rjes su/ bstod la zhabs su tshe 'gug gdags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das yab yum la bstod pa byas pas thugs mnyes pas thugs ka nas/ sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas tshe rten la thim par mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil rdo rje phyag bya'i stangs ka sngags ring / sngags thung nyer gcig de nas mda' dar thogs la/ tshig gzhung ni sngags la gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med/ /sku mdog mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /gsung mchog yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /thugs mchog mi rtog pa yi thugs/ /mkha' 'dra'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje tshe chog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig /rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye mahā puṣ+ye a pa ri mi ta ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsit+te swā hā/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra āḥyu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃ āḥyur dz+nyā na sid+dhi bh+rūṃ/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa brjod/ tshe 'gug pa dngos ni/ thugs las sgo ma bzhi spros te/ /bskul ba sngags dang bcas pas dgug /ces gsungs pa'i nyams len/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi thugs ka nas lha mo dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ shar dang shar lho'i phyogs su song bas dri za dang me lha la sogs pa/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyi lag na khyed rang rnams kyi tshe 'phrogs pa dang 'thor ba dang yar ba la sogs pa ji snyed yod pa dang / shar dang shar lho'i 'byung ba'i rtsi bcud sogs/ gzhan yang 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas tshe rten la thim par bsam/ hūm̐/ 'gugs pa'i lha mo lcags kyu ma/ /dkar mo mdzes ma lcags kyu bsnams/

/dri za'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /me lha'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /oṃ puṇ+ye sogs sngar bzhin brjod/ /lha mo zhags pa ma sngon mo dpag tu med pa spros pas lho dang lho nub kyi phyogs su song bas gshin rje dang srin po la sogs pa lha klu la sogs sngar ltar bsam zhing / hūm̐/ 'ching byed lha mo zhags pa ma/ /sngon mo mdzes ma zhags pa bsnams/ /gshin rje'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /srin po'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngar ltar brjod/ lha mo dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ nub dang nub byang gi phyogs su song bas chu lha dang rlung lha sogs dang / hūm̐/ sdom byed lha mo lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar mo mdzes ma lcags sgrog bsnams/ /klu dbang lag nas tshe khug la/ /rlung lha'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags brjod/ lha mo ljang gu dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ byang dang byang shar gyi phyogs su song bas gnod sbyin dang 'byung po sogs dang / hūm̐/ 'bebs byed lha mo dril bu ma/ /ljang gu mdzes ma dril bu bsnams/ /gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug la/ /'byung po'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags brjod/ slar lha mo rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar thim par bsam/ bden pa brdar te tshe 'gug pa ni/ mdun bskyed 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros te/ de dag la yod pa'i lha srin mthu bo che rnams kyis khyed rang rnams kyi tshe srog 'phrogs pa sogs dang / gzhan yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang bcud kyi sems can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan nus pa mthu stobs la sogs pa thams cad skad cig nyid la bsdus te tshe rten la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa ste/ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin gyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /

sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha tshogs sogs yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyiྎ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams kyiྎ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu/ 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe sde brgyad rigs drug gi lag na gnas kyang khug cig rdo rje'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis kyang / rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe 'thor ba dang / yar ba dang / phrogs pa dang / ldegs pa thams cad khug cig gzhan yang 'byung ba'i rtsi bcud/ sems can gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi tshe/ tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi rig pa'i tshe/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyi las kyi tshe la sogs pa thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la khug cig drongs shig phob cig bstims shig oṃ āḥyur+dz+nyā na hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥzhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ sngags rnams kyi skabs su 'dzab dbyangs bya zhing mda' dar gyi g.yab mo g.yob/ tshe bcing ba ni/ nyi zla ga'u rdo rje'i rwas bsdams la bzlas pa bya zhing bsdu/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus na/ tshe'i rten 'od dkar po mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam dkar la 'tsher ba'i dbus na/ rnam par shes pa'i rten yi ge ṇi ljang khu snum la 'dril ba dwangs shing gsal ba zhig yod par bsam la/ ga'u'i phyi nas steng 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bsam pa'i rwa rnams rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi thag pas bsdams pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bzlas pa bya zhing tshe bsdu ba ni/ 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis bkug nas kyang / /ma lus bum pa'i bcud la bsdu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ bum pa'i nang gi bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus nas/ mdun bskyed la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mda' dar g.yob cing / 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis bkug nas kyang / /ma lus bum pa'i bcud la bsdu/ /'chi ba med pa'i tshe thob nas/ /bla na med pa'i mchog thob shog /oṃ puṣ+ye puṣ+ye mahā puṣ+ye a pa ri mi ta āḥyuḥpuṣ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsit+te swā hā/ zhes sngags ring lan gsum tshe mda' dar g.yab dang / oṃ badz+ra āḥyuḥṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃḥ.āḥyuḥdz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci mang bzlas so/ /de nas dngos gzhi tshe'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du song nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig bdag la 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab nas/ tshe byang las/ bum lha zhu nas tshe la thim/ /de dag dpa' bo 'bru lngar gyur/ /mar me gnyis bye'i tshul du ni/ /gnas lngar bstim zhing tshe dbang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad tshe'i rten la thim/ de nyid bum pa'i lha la thim/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas bum nang gi snying po lnga la thim/ de rnams zhu ba las dpa' bo 'bru lngar gyur pa ni/ 'od dpag med dang sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo yi ge aṃ dmar po/ mi bskyod pa dang me long ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ rin 'byung dang mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo swāḥser po/

rnam snang dang chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ don grub dang bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo hā ljang khu rnams su gyur/ de rnams las de 'dra ba'i yig 'bru lnga po mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi rnam par chad nas/ khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi gtsug la sogs pa mgo bo'i gnas lngar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ yi ge 'bru lnga ye shes lnga/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni tshe yi bdag /'bru lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbang thob shog /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa twaṃ/ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā/ hoḥ tshe dbang du gyur cig dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir gyur cig skye med kyi ye shes su gyur cig bdud las rgyal bar gyur cig mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig mi nus pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig tshe bum tshe 'brang dang bcas pa lhan cig tu btegs nas slob ma'i mgo bo'i gnas lngar bzhag snying kha'i nyi zla'i ga'u'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud grol nas/ nyi zla'i ga'u kha bye ba'i nang du zhugs/ yi ge 'bru lnga las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa/ tshe dang rnam shes kyi rten la thim pas/ de nyid 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du gsal bas/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa skad cig de nyid la dag 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe sba ni/ tshe byang las/ cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gsungs pa'i don/ slob dpon gyi sngar gyi tshe 'gugs pa'i mda' dar gyi stong la dar dkris pa slob ma'i snying gar bzhag cing / snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad la phog pa 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim/ de nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor la thim/ de tshe'i rten 'od dkar po la thim/
