de rnam par shes pa'i rten ṇi yig la thim/ de nyid a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam la yun ring du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ cis kyang mi tshug mi shig pa'i/ /stong pa'i go cha bla na med/ /chos kyi phyir du tshe sbas pas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so/ /zhes brjod/ tshe brtan par bya ba ni/ tshe rten sku gsung thugs su bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'od gsal gyi ngang las khyed rang rnams sngar ltar tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyi rgyas btab pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ tshe'i dngos grub brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de'i rjes su tshe spel ba ni/ tshe spel bkra shis brjod cing spel/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas na bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma tshe'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa rnams dang gzhan yang nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa 'khor bcas/ pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas khro rgyal pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas 'chi med tshe'i lha mo tsan+dha li la sogs pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor ba/ gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas sprin gyi phung po 'thibs pa'am/ bya'i khyu chen po 'phur ba bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su byon nas/ de dag gis shes brjod dang 'dzab dbyangs kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing / me tog dang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi char chen po 'bebs par sgoms mdzod ces brjod la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dir tshogs skal ldan rdo rje'i bu/ /snying gi ze'u 'bru dad pas phye/ /mig gi pad+mo mkha' dbyings ltos/ /yid la bde chen dga' ba skyongs/ /mdun phyogs dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /rje btsun bla ma tshe dpag med/ /'chi med rig 'dzin bye bas bskor/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung gtibs/ /'dzab dbyangs rdo rje'i 'brug stong 'dir/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs/ /tshe yis dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /bde ldan yangs pa'i zhing khams nas/ /'chi med rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ /tshe yi lha dang lha mos bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la bkra shis stsol/ /pad+ma dbang gi pho brang nas/ /khro rgyal pad+ma he ru ka /tshe yi khro bo khro mos bskor/ gnas 'dirྎ /rnga yab dpal ri'i rtse mo nas/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas de/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros bskor/ gnas 'dirྎ /rgya bod phyogs bcu'i gnas chen nas/ /tshe yi brgyud ldan bla ma la/ /mched lcam dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la bkra shis stsol/ /ces brjod cing sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su puṇ+ye 'dzab bya/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor/ de nas slob ma rnams lag pa bsnol ba'i g.yas su tshe 'brang dang / g.yon du tshe bum bzhag la/ tshe ril tshe chang / lag gnyis pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser/ /'chi med dngos grub tshe yi rdzas/ /longs shig skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /lo brgya 'tsho ba'i bkra shis shog /de bzhin du/ tshe'i ril bu byin la/ dpal gyi zas mchog ril bu 'di/ /'khor 'das tshe bcud bsdus pa'i sman/ /bzos pas 'chi bdag bdud bcom nas/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /'dzab bya/ tshe chang byin la/ snying po lnga ldan rigs lnga'i bcud/ /ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /myangs pas rdo rje'i lus khengs nas/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /'dzab bya/ de nas tshe bsrings skye 'chi med pa bsrung /

/zhes gsungs pa'i don/ snying kha na tshe'i rten yod pa'i rtsa sgo smin mtshams su zla gam dmar po me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas tsan+dan gyi be con dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu 'tsher ba/ khro bo'i nyams thams cad rdzogs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gyed kyis dor stabs can gcig bzhugs pa tshe'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ a wa dhu ti'i sgo 'phar na/ /zla gam dmar po'i klong dkyil du/ /tshe yi sgo srung rta mgrin dbang / /bar chad bdud 'joms bkra shis shog /'dzab dang bcas pa brjod cing / sin+dhu ras smin mtshams su thig le bya/ de dag gis tshe'i dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa yin no/ /de'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi bka' bstod dregs pa rnams kyi gtso bo bstan srung khyad par can gying lnga dang gza' gdong gi rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ kha cig 'di rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud par bzung nas/ de mchod pa la smod pa ni chos rgyus shin tu chung zhing log rtog 'ba' zhig la rings par chas pa snying rje ba'i gnas yin te/ rgyud las 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs kyi sprul par bshad cing / slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa dang / lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na la sogs pas/ 'di dag rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis mchod cing bsten par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gdul bya 'dul byed dang / gnyen po dang las kyi lha'i khyad par gyis 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i dregs byed de dag gis kyang rnal 'byor pa la bar chad mi byed cing / 'phrin las ched du sgrub pa ni rten 'brel gyi che bar snang bas 'di rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang /

lhan cig tu grub nas da khyod rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ thog mar rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum brjod/ bla ma dbang chen he tu ka'i/ /zhabs la spyi bos gus pas 'dud/ /bcom ldan pad+ma dbang chen gyi/ /bka' nyan bka' bsgo'i rjes gnang stsol/ /de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o snyam pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas rjes gnang gi gzhi lus 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim nas gying lnga gza' gdong spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi g.yon phyogs su bka' bstod kyi tshul du 'god pa ni/ dbus su dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ 'od kyi mi bo che dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon 'od kyi zhags pa thogs pa/ sku la seṅge'i slog pa gsol zhing / dbu la ji dar dkar po bcings pa/ nam mkha' 'ja'i skye rags can/ lcags kyi sder mo rnon pos dgra rnying 'byin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i seng ge dkar mo rngam sgra sgrog pa la chibs pa/ shar du tshangs pa dung gi thor gtsug can/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang / g.yon zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral gu gsol zhing /

dbu la dung gi cod pan bcings la/ rta dkar po ngang ring la chibs pa/ lhor dam can rdo rje legs pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bse'i rdo rje dang / g.yon tsit+ta dmar po thogs pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol zhing / dbu la bse man gyi 'gying thod bcings pa/ rta kham pa/ lag dkar la chibs pa/ nub tu bdud po ri nag sprungs pa mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing dang / g.yon zhags pa nag po 'debs pa/ sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol zhing / dbu la bdud zhā nag po gsol ba/ bdud rta nag po zhon pa/ byang du srog bdag yaṃ shud dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang / g.yon zhags pa dmar po dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gsol ba/ bse'i ra skyes kham pa la chibs pa/ lnga ka'ang rngams shing khros la drag cing rtsub pa'i rnam pa can/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus me dpung 'bar zhing sprin dang rlung nag bu yug 'tshub pa/ thog dang ser ba drag tu 'bab cing / 'brug dang glog dmar 'khyug pa'i sgra sgrog cing / gnam sa cha lang bsdeb pa lta bu'i klong dkyil du/ ra ma tsa sha ya rnams las 'od 'phros yongs su gyur pa las/ khro rgyal pad+ma he ru ka'i thugs kyi sprul pa gza' rgod drag po ra hu la/ sku mdog dud kha srin po khros pa lta bu'i mgo dgu pa/ phyag g.yas kyis skyin thang gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phyar nas dgra bo'i yul du 'phen cing / phyag g.yon chu srin gyi zhags pas dam nyams 'ching zhing za ba/ lus po thams cad mig gis gang ba/ lte ba man chad dug sbrul nag po'i gzugs kyis rgya mtsho'i gting nas dkrug pa/ de'i shar du zor srin dkar mo stag gi gdong can/ lhor bam srin ser mo dred kyi gdong can/ nub tu kong srin dmar mo ba lang gi gdong can/

byang du 'brog srin ljang khu chu srin gyi gdong can/ bzhi ka'ang srin mo khros pa'i rnam pa/ g.yas zor ba dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ skad cig nyid la dgra bo'i yul khams thal bar rlog par byed pa/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ rgyal yul nam mkha' chad chod nas tshangs pa dung gi thor gtsug can/ nub phyogs pha wang long bu'i mkhar nang nas dam can rdo rje legs pa/ bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu nas bdud po ri nag spungs pa/ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas btsan 'gong yaṃ shud dmar po/ lho nub mtshams kyi srin yul langs ka pu ri'i grong khyer nas dregs pa gza' rgod lcam dral lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa e h+ya hi badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ ra tsa tri hri shu ra hu la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol tog cing / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ra tsa srog la hrīḥ a shug+me tri srog la dzaḥ tsa pa la a shug dzaḥ tri li dzaḥ badz+ra sa du hriḥ dun dun shu la gri wa ra hu la ma ra tsa sha ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+na sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu ya theṃ baṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñtsa ṭha dzi gha tha pi pa tha ma ti pra ma tha ma ma sarba kar+tha ya sad su khaṃ bi shud dhe sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum dang / ra tsa tri hri shu ra hu la ma ra tsa sha ya mahā paṃñtsa a mri ta la khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā his sman raka phul/ dbang drag dkyil 'khor spyi yi bka' bstod ni/ /srog la dbang bsgyur gying chen lnga rnams dang / /phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /dam can bka' bstod gza' gdong lcam dral rnams/

/ma lus sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gying lnga gza' gdong 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig de ltar rjes gnang gi gzhi lus bsgrubs nas/ rjes gnang dngos la thog mar snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mgon po bdag gi bzung lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi g.yon phyogs na bzhugs pa'i gying lnga gza' gdong la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi sku las sku dang / mgrin pa nas sngags dang / thugs ka nas ral gri la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byon te sku dang sngags rnams ngo bo dang phyag mtshan 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la spyi bor me tog bzhag ste/ mgon po 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas bka' bsgo ba'i slad du dpal gtor khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang / gying lnga gza' gdong gi gtor ma lag tu gtad de/ de'i nam mkha' la bla ma yi dam rnams sprin thibs pa ltar bzhugs nas bka' bsgos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta sogs gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags dang / oṃ ha ya gṛ ba hrīḥdabang / pad+ma bhan+dha hrīḥdabang / bha mo bhan+dha ya hrīḥdabang /

tsakra a si hrīḥdabang / pa shaṃ ku ru hrīḥdzaḥrā dza srog la hrīḥ a shug+me tri srog la dzaḥ tri dun dun badz+ra pa shwa t+yaṃ/ shu la gṛ ba tsa ma a shug tri tri mi dzaḥ a mu ka tsit+ta rbad bh+yoḥ hriḥraṃ pa shaṃ ku ru pad+ma ban+dha/ ba mo dha ya/ tsan+da rak+ka pad+ma ta kri ta/ dz+wa la raṃ/ ma ma sha ri traka rak+sha rak+ta rngubs dz+wa la raṃ/ ra hu la si si/ badz+ra yak+sha dz+wa la raṃ/ ma ma rak+ta dz+wā mu kha yā ya bh+yoḥ tsa ra yak+sha dz+wa la raṃ/ badz+ra shad shad/ dgra bgegs srog la rbad bh+yoḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ lo chen bai ro tsa na/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston rkyang po grags pa dbang phyug sum pa dbang phyug tshul khrims/ 'bre shob bla ma/ 'bru tshar gyi zhang ston gzi brjid 'bar/ rta nag gi bla ma rgya/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phya ru ba/ chos rgyal bo dong rin chen/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ brag dmar chos rgyal dpal bzang / kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge rnam grol ba rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ mus srad rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med dkon mchog dpal bzang / nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/ nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/ 'dar nag rgyal sras bde ba bzang po/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ drin can rdo rje 'chang pad+ma 'phrin las/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal gnas gsar ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas bsrung ba dang /

bskyab pa dang / sba ba dang / 'go ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po dang the'u rang gi gnod pa la sogs pa thams cad zhi ba dang / gzhan yang gzugs can dgra'i gnod pa/ gzugs med bgegs kyi gnod pa/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong mnan gtad gzer gsum la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa dbang du bsdus nas zas gos longs spyod la sogs pas 'phongs pa med pa dang / de dag gis kyang bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na gang la gang mtshams pa'i chad pas bcad de log sgrub mtha' dag myur du tshar gcod cing zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig mdor na dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du lus dang grib ma lta bu'i tshul gyis 'grogs nas 'go zhing 'ches pa dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi go 'phang thob pa'i 'phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen mdzod cig ces brjod cing dril bsil rol chen sogs byas la gong gi sngags brjod/ rol mo bzhag la de ltar brjod pas gying lnga gza' gdong 'khor dang bcas pas kyang zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por mngon par dbang bskur ba dang de dang rjes 'brel lugs 'di'i 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba/

bka' bstod dam can rgya mtsho'i bka' gtad dang bcas pa legs par gsan pa yin pas gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /dbang bzhi tshe dbang bka' gtad dang bcas pa legs par gsan pa'i bka' drin btang rag gi yon du dmigs pas maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐ nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma la yon du phul te cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi nang mtshan pad+ma gsung gi gtso bo dpal pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / 'chi med tshe'i rdzong chung gi sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / gying lnga gza' gdong dang bcas pa'i bka' gtad zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas des rang gzhan gyi don mtha' yas par mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang / theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di las/ /sogs chos bsngo gang shes brjod la slob ma rang gnas su btang / yang na dbang bskur rkyang pa byed na/ dbang bzhi pa rdzogs pa'i rjes su dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs pa man gong bzhin la/

de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas sogs tshig gi khyad par bsgyur shes par bya'o/ /zhes pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma rjes su gzung ba cha lag dang bcas pa 'di ni/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seṅges mdzad pa'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu la lha dbang gi lhan thabs sbyar/ bla chen chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed dang / rat+na shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i dbang chu dngos grub 'byung gnas rnams la tshar chen yab sras kyi phyag len sbyar ba'i legs bshad rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba ldeng 'dren iṇ+ḍa sa mu dras mdzad pa dang / tshe dbang gi yi ge tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ gying lnga gza' gdong rjes gnang gi bde cung yi ge rnying pa rnams la dam pa gong ma'i phyag len gyis brgyan te sa skya lo tsā ba kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sde dge sman pa bla ma sngags ram pa dkon mchog grags pa sogs don gnyer can mang pos bskul ba bzhin sbyar ba'i dge bas rdo rje theg pa'i bshad grub kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma rjes 'dzin dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
